topography.project_purpose: This brief describes the observed EVM deployment and audit surface for Equilibria. It intentionally limits the description to receipted repository and on-chain evidence instead of inferring a business model.
topography.relationship_narrative: The pinned logic-topography run contains 180 contract row(s) across arbitrum, base, berachain, bsc, ethereum, hyperliquid, mantle, optimism, plasma, sonic. Structural roles: 121 unclassified, 53 core, 6 supporting. 41 row(s) use upgradeable patterns.
